title: Dark glass agency sidebar with glowing blue accent and hover tooltips
contains_third_party_content: Photo avatars and a logo mark appear in the mockup; the visible names 'Aceagency.Design' and 'AmirBaqian' are in-mockup content and are not confirmed as the creator.

color.method: Pixel sampling via median-cut quantization of the supplied JPEG/GIF (compressed images, so values are approximate within a few units). Entries marked 'approx' were judged by eye, not sampled.
color.roles: Near-black neutral surfaces with cool undertone, a single vivid blue accent, and a colored glow that bleeds into the surface.

observed.layout: Expanded sidebar and collapsed rail. Expanded: window dots + collapse arrow, brand lockup, MENU (6 items, one with a '2' badge), MESSAGES (4 people with unread counts), blue 'All messages' pill, user at the bottom. Collapsed: icons only; one hovered icon shows a blue tooltip pill ('Case Study') with a cursor; one messages row shows a '...' blue pill; bottom blue pill with a down arrow.
observed.hierarchy: The blue is the only saturated color, used for tooltip, count badge and CTA, so everything blue means 'interactive or attention'.
observed.typography: Rounded geometric sans, small sizes, white on dark with grey secondary text (unconfirmed face).
observed.iconography: Small filled icons in grey, consistent size.
observed.materials: Dark frosted panels, soft blue outer glow under blue pills.

interpretation.aesthetic: Dark premium dashboard, glassmorphism with a neon accent.
implementation_notes: Glow: box-shadow with the accent color at low alpha and large blur, or a blurred pseudo-element behind the pill.
Hover tooltip in the collapsed rail replaces the missing label and is part of the concept's answer to 'what happens when collapsed'.
Message list lives in a recessed darker inset card.

concept_work.essence: A dark glass rail where one electric color means 'act here', and hover tooltips solve the collapsed state.
what_makes_it_work: The collapsed-state hover tooltip is shown, not left implied.
Inset card separates communication from navigation.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Small grey-on-near-black text is likely below contrast guidelines.
Tooltips need keyboard focus and touch equivalents.
Glow effects read poorly on low-contrast displays.

lessons: Limiting saturated color to one hue makes it function as an interaction signal.
Document collapsed-state behavior in the concept itself.
